cd /workspace/submission && python3 -c "
import os
total=0; count=0
for root, dirs, files in os.walk('.'):
    for d in dirs: count+=1
    for f in files:
        p=os.path.join(root,f)
        assert os.path.isfile(p) and not os.path.islink(p), p
        total+=os.lstat(p).st_size; count+=1
print('files+dirs', count, 'bytes', total)
" && python3 -B -c "import py_compile,sys
for f in ['main.py','controller.py','planner.py','validate.py']:

print('compile ok')"
